scope: LOCAL synthetic development example only; not a release authorization

enable_requires: all listed gates resolved to CLEARED with recorded evidence
resolution_rules.note: A flag enabled=true alone does NOT grant release permission; every 'gates' entry below must be independently CLEARED by the owner/legal/Play/Android-OS authority before real-data use. Absence of a gate record means NOT CLEARED.

FR-001_secure_pairing.notes: Parent/child secure pairing; synthetic only. Non-sensitive foundational flow.

FR-002_transparent_permission_onboarding.notes: Transparent disclosure before permission requests; no stealth. Required always-on behavior, not a data-collection feature.

FR-003_location_observations_live.notes: Live/background location. X-02/X-03 gates OPEN; capture disabled.

FR-004_travel_route_history.notes: Derived history. Six-hour free visibility is a query window, not retention approval (C-02/C-14).

FR-005_usage_statistics.notes: App usage behavioral data needs independent legal + Play review.

FR-006_authenticated_remote_commands.notes: Command dispatch gated on per-child guardian authorization + capability recheck.

FR-007_scheduled_screen_time_restriction.notes: Managed mode deferred for first release (B-05). Standard mode returns UNSUPPORTED_POLICY.

FR-008_file_media_access.notes: App-owned / SAF-selected URIs only; no private directories or all-files access.

FR-009_authorized_photo_video_capture.notes: P3 research. OFF by default; visible child-initiated foreground only if ever approved. No covert/background capture.

FR-010_authorized_audio_capture.notes: P3 research. OFF by default. No covert listening; mic indicator never hidden.

FR-011_google_drive_backup.notes: Opt-in only (B-15 P2). OFF by default.

FR-050_screen_capture_projection.notes: Screen share stays OFF; no reliable pre-frame financial-screen classifier exists. FLAG_SECURE respected.

media_p2p_transport.notes: WebRTC/ICE/STUN+TURN transport design only (MA-P2P-ADR-004). Capture OFF for children.
